items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: either Al Avola, the guitarist or a trombone player called Rogers -- the five of us rode together down south

ctx.x: she sang on the bandstand and she roomed with Billie, and our past discussions about the racial question, one night in New England of all places, they didn't want to let us in the hotel because we were playing a college town, so Artie Shaw did not check in a hotel unless the whole band checked in, and she roomed -- my first wife, with Billie. They were roommates.

So we went through several scenes that way. Then we went down on a southern tour and Billie rode with Sid Weiss, the bass player, and I rode with him, and I forget who -- either Al Avola, the guitarist or a trombone player called Rogers -- the five of us rode together down south because things were very rough.
Excuse me. When you say rode together, you weren't in the bus with the band?
